sources.beginner: hand-calc closed form from the prompt, worked step by step on ORON in src/content/courses/heattransfer/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l03-the-capstone-worked.md; panels have no case inputs; tolerances derived in src/components/course/panels/heattransfer/gradedTolerance.js as max(stated, half a unit of the printed decimals).
sources.intermediate: hand-calc for the five-resistance stack (formulas described in intermediate/m03 lessons); the correction factor and the equivalent single-shell P need a closed form the lessons never write, and the only calculator, Suite src/components/heatexchanger/SizingPanels.jsx:160-166, prints P and F to 3 decimals and no equivalent P.
sources.advanced: hand-calc closed form (UA = Q/LMTD, Cr, NTU = UA/Cmin, held effectiveness) as worked in src/content/courses/heattransfer/advanced/m06-the-expert-reading/l02-the-capstone-worked.md; Suite RatingCoolerPanels.jsx prints 1-2 decimals only.
